text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room before the start of<n>the Japan
Cup, Symboli Rudolf<n>exchanges friendly greetings
with her<n>younger rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But even when her thoughts are on<n>the past and
the future, her sights are<n>on the track. Today, as
ever, she will<n>do her duty as the Emperor.
